items.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
items.summary: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: UK Police Seize $1.4M in Bitcoin Traced to Shuttered Darknet Markets
items.summary: The 20.21 BTC was linked to marketplaces running between 2016 and 2019, and the man who held it died before it was forfeited.

items.title: Investors at least $4.7 billion underwater across Trump crypto ventures, Public Citizen says
items.summary: Investors are $4.7 billion underwater across Trump crypto ventures while Trump earned $1.4 billion, Public Citizen reported.
